Just got my spring order from Calen and WOW!! For anyone who hasn't ordered from Calen in the past, he is hands down my favorite Sarracenia vendor. So much quality stuff in here that is going to look AMAZING once it gets growing. Do yourself a favor and order now!

All the plants laid out


There's a mitchelliana in here that I cannot wait to see pitcher up!


The plants on the far left here were supposed to be seedlings, but have rhizomes the size of golf balls and many growth points!


All potted up ready for their new home!

Made an order early April, but I decided on another this week!


Leuco (Wilkerson's Red Rocket x Purple Lips).
Looking great for spring pitchers! Can't wait to see the fall crop.

A full shot of his Bloodmoon remake! Pitcher measures at 19 inches. Another to look forward to in the fall.

And finally two seedlings of minor okefenokeensis (Phil's x R.P.) on the left. He was kind enough to throw in the second one as a freebie, along with the okee minor (Wang's x King's) to the right of them.
Will definitely come back again for more!

Calen's plants are pretty and vigorous! I was very impressed with what he sent to me, large clumps and tall pitchers. One of them is over 2' tall. I am very happy with what I got!!


I usually ordered 1-2 plants from a new seller just to try if they have good plants or not. But with Calen, because I have seen a lot of good feedback from people here and Instagram, I knew I would get great quality plants from him so I decided to get several plants for my first order. I'd have to say, I am happy to say that I was very pleased! Calen also knows how to please customers.. he gave me FREEBIES!!! multiple pitchers and rhizomes are huge!

Overall, after buying plants from different sellers/growers for a while, I'd say Calen has one of the highest quality plants. Not sure why I did not buy plants from him sooner.. but I am sure that I am definitely going to buy plants from him in the future

posts.body_html:
Despite wishing to temporarily close, and because he missed my emails earlier this year, Calen graciously agreed to ship an order to me!

It was my first time getting plants from Calen and I was super impressed with the size and health of the plants; top-notch, to be sure!

I am a long-time grower of carnivorous plants, primarily a Venus flytrap lover, but recently have really gotten interested in Sarracenia for the first time in many years. I've ordered my pitcher plants over the years and Calen's are some of the best I've seen and his prices are unbeatable.

Looking forward to my next order!

posts.body_html:
I genuinely think Calen is in the wrong business selling Sarracenia. He should go into the stock market, competitive poker, or that game where you guess which cup the ball is under. Because he is a mind reader!

I am hoping to establish a healthy stock of alata and alata hybrids as part of the backbone of my collection. Because I'm balling on a budget (and birthday gift cards), I ordered 1 alata night x sib clone recently. It checked every box I have for a dark alata with great breeding potential. 

My purchase came with some wonderful freebies, including an AF areolata that I had my list on for next year!

Do yourself a favor and buy Sarracenia from Calen. Just be prepared to have your mind blown.
